entities.name: Francis Xavier Truong Buu Diep
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francis Xavier Truong Buu Diep was a Vietnamese Catholic priest who served the people of Bạc Liêu Province. He was killed for the faith in 1946 and is set to be beatified in the Catholic Church on 2 July 2026 by Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle at Tắc Sậy Church in Cà Mau.
